from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer

# Create a PDF document
doc = SimpleDocTemplate("pdf_trends.pdf", pagesize=letter)

# Define styles
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
title_style = styles['Heading1']
title_style.textColor = '#2c3e50'
heading_style = styles['Heading2']
heading_style.textColor = '#3498db'
body_style = styles['BodyText']
body_style.textColor = '#333'

# Content
content = []

# Title
content.append(Paragraph("PDF Trends", title_style))
content.append(Spacer(1, 0.2 * inch))

# Trends
trends = [
    {
        "title": "PDF trends in 2025, according to AI - PDF Association",
        "body": "PDF technology continues to grow globally, driven by digital transformation, AI integration, and regulatory compliance. Trends show increasing use in cloud workflows, e-signatures, accessibility, and secure document exchange. AI-enhanced search and automation are reshaping how PDFs are managed."
    },
    {
        "title": "How PDFs Are Evolving: Future Trends Every User Should Know",
        "body": "The PDF format is evolving with AI integration, advanced security models, and future-ready encryption. Organizations and individuals are better positioned to improve efficiency, strengthen document security, and maintain long-term compatibility as standards continue to evolve."
    },
    {
        "title": "The Future of PDFs: Innovations and Trends to Watch - All About PDF",
        "body": "AI-driven content extraction is revolutionizing the way information is extracted from PDFs. Mobile-first document design is becoming more common, with PDFs optimized for mobile viewing. Integration of multimedia elements such as videos, audio clips, and interactive features is enhancing the user experience."
    },
    {
        "title": "Adobe Acrobat's latest update could make working with PDFs considerably easier - Digital Trends",
        "body": "Adobe Acrobat's latest update adds Generate Report and Stylize, giving professionals new ways to work with information-heavy PDFs and create more polished documents."
    },
    {
        "title": "The Future Is Now: Emerging Trends in the World of PDFs - INSCMagazine",
        "body": "Interactive PDFs are gaining momentum, turning PDFs into dynamic platforms where users can engage with content in ways never imagined before. PDFs are moving to the cloud, allowing for real-time collaboration and making teamwork more efficient. Accessibility features are becoming standard, ensuring that everyone can access and understand the content."
    }
]

for trend in trends:
    content.append(Paragraph(trend["title"], heading_style))
    content.append(Paragraph(trend["body"], body_style))
    content.append(Spacer(1, 0.2 * inch))

# Build the PDF
doc.build(content)

"PDF generated successfully."
